capabilityHints.summary: Collectors acquire $RELICS on the canonical pool and awaken Relic NFTs whose visual condition is permanently forged by the real market history this hook records; traders experience a completely standard 0.30% v4 pool that the hook can observe but never alter, tax or refuse.

components.summary: Immutable Uniswap v4 market-history observer for one canonical $RELICS/WETH pool: afterInitialize, afterAddLiquidity and afterSwap record permanent GlobalMarketState that a fully on-chain art renderer reads; no before-hooks, no return deltas, no fee mechanism, no custody.

project.summary: The live RELICS market-history hook: an immutable, ownerless Uniswap v4 observer on Ethereum mainnet that turns real trading on one canonical $RELICS/WETH pool into permanent on-chain state consumed by a fully on-chain generative art collection. Submitted as an explicitly authorized public flagship reference of an already-deployed project, not as a new launch request.
